title: Selection and projection (σ, π)
sql:
SELECT asset_code, status, capacity_kwh
FROM Asset
WHERE asset_type = 'BATTERY_PACK' AND capacity_kwh > 50
ORDER BY capacity_kwh DESC

title: Inner join (⋈)
sql:
SELECT a.asset_code, p.passport_id, p.passport_version
FROM Asset a
JOIN Passport p ON p.asset_id = a.asset_id AND p.status = 'ACTIVE'
WHERE a.asset_type = 'BATTERY_PACK'
ORDER BY a.asset_code

title: Left outer join: packs with NO active passport
sql:
SELECT a.asset_code, a.status
FROM Asset a
LEFT JOIN Passport p ON p.asset_id = a.asset_id AND p.status = 'ACTIVE'
WHERE a.asset_type = 'BATTERY_PACK' AND p.passport_id IS NULL

title: GROUP BY and HAVING
sql:
SELECT manufacturer, COUNT(*) AS packs, ROUND(SUM(capacity_kwh), 1) AS total_kwh
FROM Asset
WHERE asset_type = 'BATTERY_PACK'
GROUP BY manufacturer
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1
ORDER BY packs DESC

title: Subquery with IN
sql:
SELECT asset_code, status
FROM Asset
WHERE asset_id IN (SELECT asset_id FROM LifecycleEvent WHERE event_type = 'REPURPOSED')

title: Correlated subquery: latest event per asset
sql:
SELECT a.asset_code,
       (SELECT e.event_type FROM LifecycleEvent e
        WHERE e.asset_id = a.asset_id
        ORDER BY e.event_at DESC, e.event_id DESC LIMIT 1) AS latest_event
FROM Asset a
ORDER BY a.asset_code

title: Window function: latest event per asset
sql:
SELECT asset_code, event_type, event_at
FROM (
  SELECT a.asset_code, e.event_type, e.event_at,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.asset_id ORDER BY e.event_at DESC, e.event_id DESC) AS rn
  FROM LifecycleEvent e JOIN Asset a ON a.asset_id = e.asset_id
)
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY asset_code

title: Set difference (EXCEPT): assets with no event
sql:
SELECT asset_code
FROM Asset
WHERE asset_id IN (SELECT asset_id FROM Asset
                   EXCEPT
                   SELECT asset_id FROM LifecycleEvent)
ORDER BY asset_code

title: Recursive CTE: everything a cell ends up inside
sql:
WITH RECURSIVE up(asset_id, depth) AS (
  SELECT asset_id, 0 FROM Asset WHERE asset_code = 'CELL-1001-A1'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT r.parent_asset_id, u.depth + 1
  FROM up u JOIN v_open_relationship r ON r.child_asset_id = u.asset_id
)
SELECT u.depth, a.asset_code, a.asset_type
FROM up u JOIN Asset a ON a.asset_id = u.asset_id
ORDER BY u.depth

title: Temporal query: who held a module on a date?
sql:
SELECT p.asset_code AS parent, r.valid_from, r.valid_to
FROM AssetRelationship r
JOIN Asset p ON p.asset_id = r.parent_asset_id
JOIN Asset c ON c.asset_id = r.child_asset_id
WHERE c.asset_code = 'MOD-4001-A'
  AND r.valid_from <= '2024-12-01'
  AND (r.valid_to IS NULL OR r.valid_to > '2024-12-01')

title: Integrity rule DQ-002 as plain SQL
sql:
SELECT c.asset_code, COUNT(*) AS open_parents, GROUP_CONCAT(p.asset_code, ', ') AS parents
FROM v_open_relationship r
JOIN Asset c ON c.asset_id = r.child_asset_id
JOIN Asset p ON p.asset_id = r.parent_asset_id
GROUP BY r.child_asset_id
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1

title: Querying a VIEW
sql:
SELECT asset_code, status, passport_id, open_parents, last_event_at
FROM v_asset_overview
WHERE open_parents > 1 OR passport_id IS NULL
ORDER BY asset_code

title: EXPLAIN: index used (look for SEARCH ... USING INDEX)
sql:
EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN
SELECT event_type, event_at
FROM LifecycleEvent
WHERE asset_id = 'A001'
ORDER BY event_at DESC

title: EXPLAIN: no index on location (look for SCAN)
sql:
EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN
SELECT * FROM LifecycleEvent
WHERE location = 'Chennai, India'

title: Hash chain: each row stores the previous row's hash
sql:
SELECT event_id, event_type,
       substr(prev_hash, 1, 12) AS prev_hash,
       substr(event_hash, 1, 12) AS event_hash
FROM LifecycleEvent
ORDER BY event_id
LIMIT 6

title: Diagnostic measurements (Case Study Code 3: FR-5)
sql:
SELECT t.test_time, a.asset_code, t.state_of_health_pct, t.cycle_count, t.recorded_by
FROM TestResult t
JOIN Asset a ON a.asset_id = t.asset_id
WHERE a.asset_code = 'PACK-1001'
ORDER BY t.test_time DESC
LIMIT 5

title: Passport succession history (EU 2023/1542 Art. 77(7))
sql:
SELECT p.passport_id, a.asset_code, p.passport_version, p.status, p.issued_at, p.previous_passport_id, COALESCE(prev.status, 'INITIAL_ISSUANCE') AS previous_status
FROM Passport p
JOIN Asset a ON a.asset_id = p.asset_id
LEFT JOIN Passport prev ON prev.passport_id = p.previous_passport_id
ORDER BY a.asset_code, p.passport_version

title: Circular economy decision matrix (EU Art. 14 / BWMR)
sql:
SELECT a.asset_code, a.asset_type, a.status, t.state_of_health_pct AS latest_soh_pct, t.cycle_count,
       CASE
         WHEN t.state_of_health_pct >= 75.0 THEN 'Second-life candidate (EU Art. 14)'
         WHEN t.state_of_health_pct < 75.0  THEN 'Recycle / Hydrometallurgy (BWMR)'
         ELSE 'Diagnostics pending'
       END AS circularity_recommendation
FROM Asset a
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT asset_id, state_of_health_pct, cycle_count,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY asset_id ORDER BY test_time DESC) AS rn
  FROM TestResult
) t ON t.asset_id = a.asset_id AND t.rn = 1
WHERE a.asset_type IN ('BATTERY_PACK', 'STORAGE_SYSTEM')
ORDER BY a.asset_code

title: US IRA / FEOC critical mineral multi-tier recursive trace
concept: Recursive CTE with path string aggregation
sql:
WITH RECURSIVE lineage(asset_id, parent_asset_id, depth, path) AS (
  SELECT a.asset_id, r.parent_asset_id, 1, a.asset_code
  FROM Asset a
  LEFT JOIN v_open_relationship r ON r.child_asset_id = a.asset_id
  WHERE a.batch_code = 'NC-2024-W03'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT p.asset_id, r2.parent_asset_id, l.depth + 1, l.path || ' -> ' || p.asset_code
  FROM lineage l
  JOIN Asset p ON p.asset_id = l.parent_asset_id
  LEFT JOIN v_open_relationship r2 ON r2.child_asset_id = p.asset_id
  WHERE l.parent_asset_id IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT DISTINCT l.depth, a.asset_code, a.asset_type, a.manufacturer, a.batch_code, l.path
FROM lineage l
JOIN Asset a ON a.asset_id = l.asset_id
ORDER BY l.depth DESC
